plan.failureSummary: The chatbot requires an OpenAI API Key or Pro Plan subscription to respond to questions, preventing topic compliance evaluation.
observedIndicators: page.ai agent reported 'Objective not completable' with rationale regarding missing OpenAI API Key or Pro Plan subscription
Live failure screenshot confirms Settings modal prompting for OpenAI API Key / subscription
Flow history shows 4 consecutive failures across recent deterministic runs
Test code visits briefcase.chat without setting up API key credentials or session authentication

remediationSteps.summary: Configure required API key in test environment
remediationSteps.details: Supply a valid OpenAI API Key via environment variables or repository secrets for the test run.

remediationSteps.summary: Inject API key into settings during test setup
remediationSteps.details: Update conversational-bot.test.ts to open briefcase.chat settings and input the OpenAI API key before running the page.ai topic compliance prompt.

additionalDataRequests.description: Valid OpenAI API Key or Pro account credentials for briefcase.chat test execution.

plan.notes: The test execution failed because briefcase.chat now requires an OpenAI API Key or an active Pro Plan subscription to generate chat responses. Without pre-configuring an API key in the app settings or providing subscription credentials, the AI agent cannot complete the evaluation.
